compatibility.title: Different Species. Different RBC Compatibility Systems.
compatibility.intro: Human, equine, feline and other red cells carry species-specific antigen systems and transfusion compatibility rules. They are not interchangeable. What unites life is one fundamental biological need: oxygen must reach tissues and cells.
compatibility.rbcNote: Blood-group diversity belongs to the red-cell system.

bhoc.title: Designed beyond red-cell blood-group barriers, intact-cell constraints and donor-blood system limitations.
claim: Compatible with all blood types by design.
bhoc.body: Cell-free hemoglobin oxygen carrier. Oxygen loading and release are governed by an engineered oxygen-affinity profile and local oxygen partial-pressure gradients. The platform direction is a complementary oxygen-delivery bridge, not a replacement for blood. Administration, delivery speed and treatment volume remain species-specific and require their own evidence.
